name: Andaz Miami Beach
positioning: Andaz Miami Beach Resort & Spa: an oceanfront retreat on Collins Avenue in Mid-Beach that merges Art Deco character with modern design
best_for: Travelers who want an oceanfront Miami Beach base in Mid-Beach rather than South Beach
Families or friends sharing a two-bedroom suite

facts.text: The hotel is an oceanfront retreat on Collins Avenue in Mid-Beach.
Its design merges Art Deco character with modern design, infused with local texture and detail.
The complex was originally built in the 1940s as the 18-floor Lord Tarleton Hotel, Miami Beach's first skyscraper.
The hotel occupies a full city block, with plenty of sitting areas and lounges for quiet moments.
The lobby is in hues of aqua, mint, turquoise and sage, with floor-to-ceiling windows framing views of the Atlantic.
Many rooms and suites have private balconies with oceanfront or city skyline views.
Rooms have Byredo bath amenities and a Nespresso coffee maker.
The multi-level pool decks have two pools.
Daily wellness programs feature signature classes, many complimentary for guests, from yoga flow to high-intensity interval training.
The hotel is home to three José Andrés restaurants.
Guests can use the hotel's on-site electric bikes to ride the paved beach path along the ocean.

highlights.text: The terrace swimming pool has a hydraulic floor that rises to create a solid surface for special events, a first for Miami.
The Ondara spa sits on the fourth-floor terrace, offering advanced skincare and touchless therapies with Obagi products, and its relaxation lounge has loungers with ocean views.
The Two-Bedroom Ocean Terrace Suite with Soaking Tub has two king bedrooms, an oversized soaking tub and a wraparound terrace with panoramic ocean views.
There is no check-in desk: each guest is seated and personally welcomed with a cocktail.
A historic 1929 single-family house on site has been preserved and restored as the clubhouse for a private members club on the property.

considerations.text: The hotel is in Mid-Beach: South Beach is a 15-minute drive away, though Soho House and the Fontainebleau are within walking distance.
Self-parking is on-street at Miami Beach city parking rates; the hotel itself offers valet parking.
Pets are welcome, but not in restaurants, on the pool deck or beach, in the Andaz Lounge or in the fitness center.
